nodes.name: Widow pension, Gujarat (Ganga Swarupa)
nodes.officialName: ગંગા સ્વરૂપા બહેનોને આર્થિક સહાય યોજના
nodes.description: The Gujarat state pension for widows, run by the Women and Child Development Department. Open from age 18, unlike the central widow pension, and it does not require a BPL card, only an income below the ceiling.

metadata.whyRequired: Monthly income support for a widow who has no other pension.
metadata.whatToDo: Get the application form from your Taluka Mamlatdar's office, fill it in with the proofs listed here and hand it back to the Taluka Mamlatdar. The Mamlatdar checks it and sanctions the assistance.
metadata.expectedOutput: Rs. 1250 a month credited directly into your post office account. Only the department's own page prints that figure, so confirm it at the counter.
metadata.fee: No fee for this scheme is printed on any page retrieved for this graph. Ask before you pay anything.

sources.evidence: ગંગા સ્વરૂપા બહેનોને આર્થિક સહાય યોજના
The applicant must be a widowed woman.

nodes.name: Old age pension, Gujarat (Niradhar Vriddha)
nodes.officialName: Niradhar Vriddha Pension Yojana (State Government Scheme)
nodes.description: The Gujarat state pension for destitute older people, run by the Director of Social Defence. It has a destitution test the central scheme does not have: a son or grandson aged 21 or over who can earn disqualifies you.

metadata.whyRequired: Monthly income support for an older person with nobody able to support them.
metadata.whatToDo: The form is free at the Mamlatdar's Office. You can also apply online from a Jan Seva Kendra, the Mamlatdar Office, or your Gram Panchayat, where the village computer entrepreneur files it for you. The Mamlatdar approves or rejects. If you are rejected, you have 60 days to appeal to the Provincial Officer.
metadata.expectedOutput: Rs. 1000 a month if you are 60 to 79, Rs. 1250 a month if you are 80 or more, paid by DBT into your post office or bank account.
metadata.fee: The application form itself is free at the Mamlatdar's Office. No other fee is printed on any page retrieved for this graph.

sources.evidence: Niradhar Vriddha Pension Yojana (State Government Scheme)
Elderly people of 60 years or above under this scheme.

nodes.name: Widow pension, central (IGNWPS)
nodes.officialName: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
aliases: indira gandhi national widow pension scheme
nodes.description: The central widow pension, run by the Ministry of Rural Development for widows of families below the poverty line. Separate from the Gujarat Ganga Swarupa scheme, with a different minimum age and different money.

metadata.whyRequired: Monthly central income support for a widow in a household below the poverty line.
metadata.whatToDo: Apply through the UMANG portal, or at your Mamlatdar office or Gram Panchayat, which are the bodies expected to identify beneficiaries. Official government pages state different monthly amounts for this scheme. Every published figure is listed here with the page that printed it, and none has been picked as the right one. Ask your Taluka Mamlatdar, who is the officer who sanctions the assistance, what you will actually be paid.
metadata.expectedOutput: The published figures do not agree. myScheme prints Rs. 300 a month for ages 40 to 79 and Rs. 500 for 80 and above, the NSAP page prints Rs. 200 a month for ages 40 to 59, and the Anand district page prints Rs. 700 a month. All three are official. None has been picked here.
metadata.fee: No fee for this scheme is printed on any page retrieved for this graph.

sources.evidence: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is implemented by Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. It is a non-contributory pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL) of the society.

nodes.name: Old age pension, central (IGNOAPS)
nodes.officialName: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
aliases: indira gandhi national old age pension scheme
nodes.description: The central old age pension, run by the Ministry of Rural Development for people aged 60 and above below the poverty line. Gujarat's Social Defence directorate lists it as the vayvandana scheme and tops it up from state funds.

metadata.whyRequired: Monthly central income support for an older person in a household below the poverty line.
metadata.whatToDo: Give the application at your respective Mamlatdar office or at the Jan Seva Kendra of your district collector office. Official government pages state different monthly amounts for this scheme. Every published figure is listed here with the page that printed it, and none has been picked as the right one. Ask your Taluka Mamlatdar, who is the officer who sanctions the assistance, what you will actually be paid.
metadata.expectedOutput: The published figures do not agree. Gujarat's Social Defence page prints Rs. 750 a month for ages 60 to 79 and Rs. 1000 for over 80, of which Rs. 500 is the state's own share. The central NSAP page prints Rs. 200 a month up to 79 and Rs. 500 after that. Both are official. Neither has been picked here.
metadata.fee: No fee for this scheme is printed on any page retrieved for this graph.

nodes.name: You must be at least 18, and the official pages disagree about whether it is really 40
nodes.description: The central widow pension prints two different minimum ages. myScheme states an age group of 40 to 79, the NSAP page states 40 to 59, and the Anand district page states 18 or above. The rule here admits anyone 18 or over rather than refuse a woman on a number the government has published three ways. If you are between 18 and 40, apply anyway and make the office tell you which rule they are using. The Gujarat Ganga Swarupa scheme is open from 18 either way.

nodes.name: If you are disabled, more than 75 percent disability and age 45 or above
nodes.description: The Gujarat state old age pension opens fifteen years early for a disabled applicant, at 45 instead of 60, if the disability is more than 75 percent.

nodes.name: You must have lived in Gujarat for at least 10 years
nodes.description: The Gujarat state old age pension is for applicants permanently residing in Gujarat for at least 10 years. This is a separate and harder test than simply living in Gujarat now, and the state widow pension does not have it.

sources.evidence: Applicants who have been permanently residing in Gujarat for at least 10 years.

nodes.name: You must not have a son or grandson aged 21 or over who can support you
nodes.description: The destitution test on the Gujarat state old age pension. A son or grandson of 21 or above disqualifies you, unless he is mentally unstable, disabled, unable to earn, or suffering a serious illness such as cancer or T.B., in which case you can still apply. Answer no if the only such son or grandson falls into one of those exceptions.

sources.evidence: Should not have a son or grandson of 21 years or above and if he is alive and is mentally unstable or disabled and is unable to earn or is suffering from a serious illness like cancer, T.B. then application can be made.

nodes.name: Your income must be under the ceiling, or your family must be on the BPL list
nodes.description: The Gujarat state old age pension page prints two money tests next to each other: an annual income ceiling of Rs. 1,20,000 in rural areas and Rs. 1,50,000 in urban areas, and a rural BPL score of 0 to 20. It does not say whether the BPL score replaces the income test or adds to it. Meeting either one is treated as passing here, because guessing in the direction that turns a citizen away would be the worse guess. The counter may read it the other way.

sources.evidence: The annual income of the applicant should not exceed Rs. 1,20,000/- in rural areas and Rs. 1,50,000/- in urban areas.
Applicants from rural areas should be included in the BPL list below the poverty line with a score of 0 to 20.

nodes.name: Your Gram Panchayat
nodes.description: At village level the application can be filed online from the Gram Panchayat by the village computer entrepreneur. nodes.name: The Provincial Officer, for appeals
nodes.description: If your Gujarat state old age pension application is rejected, this is the appeal. You have 60 days from the rejection. No page retrieved for this graph prints an address, a phone number or a form number for the appeal, so ask the Mamlatdar who rejected you.

sources.evidence: There is a provision to file an appeal application to the Provincial Officer within 60 days of the rejected application.

nodes.name: UMANG portal

questions.label: Are you a widow?
questions.help: Both widow pensions are for widowed women. The state one is open from age 18, the central one is disputed between 18 and 40.

questions.label: Do you live in a rural or an urban area?
questions.help: The income ceiling is Rs. 1,20,000 a year in rural areas and Rs. 1,50,000 in urban areas, so this changes which limit applies to you.

questions.label: Is your household on the below poverty line list?
questions.help: The central pensions are only for BPL households. The Gujarat state schemes use an income ceiling instead.

questions.label: What is your family's BPL score?
questions.help: It is on your BPL card. Gujarat asks for 0 to 20 for the central old age pension, and the Anand district page asks for 0 to 16, so the two do not agree.

questions.label: Have you remarried?
questions.help: The central widow pension stops on remarriage.

questions.label: What percentage disability is on your certificate?
questions.help: More than 75 percent opens the Gujarat old age pension from 45 instead of 60.

questions.label: How many years have you lived in Gujarat?
questions.help: The state old age pension needs at least 10 years of permanent residence. Living here now is not enough on its own.

questions.label: Do you have a son or grandson aged 21 or over who is able to support you?
questions.help: Answer no if he is mentally unstable, disabled, unable to earn, or suffering a serious illness such as cancer or T.B. The scheme page treats those as exceptions and you can still apply.
